messages:
maria: Quick question—what should the API return when auth is missing vs invalid vs lacks org access? Need exact status codes + response body shape so SDK can surface helpful messages.

alex: Policy we discussed: 401 when no credentials or token expired; 403 when token valid but not authorized for org/project. 400 for malformed auth header. Keep response body consistent: error.code, error.message, maybe error.details.

maria: Can you paste an example shape? Also: older SDKs sometimes only send X-Project header—do we still accept that during rotation?

alex: Example:

```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "auth.no_credentials",
    "message": "No API key provided",
    "hint": "Provide an Authorization: Bearer <key> header or set X-API-Key"
  }
}
```

For 403:

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "auth.insufficient_scope",
    "message": "Key does not have access to project X",
    "project_id": "proj_123"
  }
}
```

alex: Rotation/compat: we will temporarily accept X-Project/X-API-Key for 30 days while emitting `X-Deprecated-Auth: true` response header and a warning in the body. After grace period we return 401 if only deprecated headers present.

sam: For key rotation: if a key is in grace revocation window should we return 403 or 401? We rotate by reissuing and marking old keys as soft-disabled.

alex: Soft-disabled -> return 401 with code `auth.revoked_soft` and include `retry_after` if applicable. Hard revoked -> 403.

jordan: Do we include WWW-Authenticate header on 401s so browsers/clients can show dialogs? Also telemetry: team wants a counter for 401 vs 403 by route.

alex: Yes, include `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token"` on 401. We'll add telemetry tags: auth_status and auth_method and route. Will surface in console and logs.

sre-bot: Deploy note: canary starts tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll post alert on rollouts channel and watch 401 spike.

maria: Great. I'll update SDK error mapping and add deprecation warning. Will share PR link when ready. :thumbsup:
